basis: Frozen onboarding showback estimates, available at the existing POC cutoff to include retained acceptance probes. Never ledger, access or enforcement rates; not invoices.
assumptions: Rates approved from planning research; not freshly fetched during source implementation. GlobalStandard text-chat estimates only. Context limits below are conservative estimation applicability, not advertised model capabilities. Native Anthropic input excludes cache reads and writes, but APIM finops-v1 normalizes persisted input to inclusive prompt totals for every provider. Usage estimates subtract cache subsets from that inclusive total; native accounting metadata is provenance only. Missing native cache counts and positive native cache writes with unverified TTL remain unestimated. The quoted write rate is the five-minute tier, not evidence that a request used that TTL. Fast alias requires independently accepted usage.speed=fast, not a latency or name inference. No invoice, discount, tax, tools, images or hosting guarantees.
